labels.shortDescription: Data hygiene checks: card title in Org Optimizer's Data quality section.
labels.value: Data quality

labels.shortDescription: Data hygiene page introduction.
labels.value: Records that need tidying up, counted with your own access. Open a check in Find to read, export or change its records. Nothing here changes a record.

labels.shortDescription: How data hygiene differs from Health Check.
labels.value: Health Check says whether BarnCRM is set up right. This page is about the records themselves.

labels.shortDescription: Button that runs every check again.
labels.value: Recount

labels.shortDescription: Shown while the checks run.
labels.value: Counting records

labels.shortDescription: Button that opens a check in Find.
labels.value: Open in Find

labels.shortDescription: Caption under a check's count.
labels.value: records found

labels.shortDescription: Toast after a check opens, {0} is the saved query name.
labels.value: In Find, choose "{0}" from Saved queries.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal without the Find and Export Records permission.
labels.value: Data hygiene needs the Find and Export Records permission. Ask your administrator to assign you the BarnCRM Find and Export permission set.

labels.shortDescription: Note on the people check when some are person accounts.
labels.value: The count includes people kept as person accounts. Find lists contacts only, so those are not in the list. Health Check links the first five.

labels.shortDescription: Shown on a check whose records the person cannot read.
labels.value: You cannot see the records this check reads. Ask whoever manages access in your org.

labels.shortDescription: Shown when a check fails unexpectedly.
labels.value: This check could not run. The details are in the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal for a check key the page does not know.
labels.value: That check does not exist. Reload the Data Hygiene page and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the saved query a check opens, {0} is the check title.
labels.value: Data hygiene: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Count past the cap, {0} is the cap.
labels.value: More than {0}

labels.shortDescription: Check title: people with no household.
labels.value: People with no household

labels.shortDescription: Check detail, contact mode.
labels.value: Contacts with no account. They are left out of household names, greetings, totals and mailings.

labels.shortDescription: Check detail, junction mode.
labels.value: People, contacts or person accounts, with no current household membership. They are left out of household names, greetings, totals and mailings.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: households with nobody in them.
labels.value: Households with nobody in them

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: empty households.
labels.value: Households whose Member Count is zero or empty. Add a member, merge the household into another, or delete it.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: memberships that name nobody.
labels.value: Memberships that name nobody

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: membership rows with no person.
labels.value: Household membership records whose person was deleted while automation was off. They count for nobody and can be deleted.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: addresses that belong to nobody.
labels.value: Addresses that belong to nobody

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: addresses with no owner.
labels.value: Address records whose household, organization or person was deleted. Delete them, or give them an owner.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: default addresses with parts missing.
labels.value: Default addresses with parts missing

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: incomplete default addresses.
labels.value: The address each household, organization or person is mailed at, with no street, city or postal code. Mail sent there will not arrive.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: default addresses that failed verification.
labels.value: Default addresses that failed verification

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: failed verification.
labels.value: Default addresses an address verification app marked Failed. Without such an app this is always 0.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: people nobody can reach.
labels.value: People with no way to reach them

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: people nobody can reach.
labels.value: Living people with no email, no phone, no mobile and no mailing city or postal code. Nothing you send can reach them.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: deceased people who can still be emailed.
labels.value: Deceased people who can still be emailed

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: deceased people who can still be emailed.
labels.value: People marked Deceased who have an email address and are not opted out of email. Tick Email Opt Out so no message goes to them.

labels.shortDescription: Check title: people not changed for years; {0} is the years.
labels.value: People not changed in {0} years

labels.shortDescription: Check detail: people not changed for years.
labels.value: People nobody has changed for the number of years set in BarnCRM Settings (General). Review them before you decide to archive or delete any.
